description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Feed video actions:** The Watch later button no longer goes missing on feed videos when you scroll back up. Videos whose details are shown before their thumbnail duration now get the button as soon as the thumbnail appears.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.22.0...v1.22.1)
